intent: Start in broad meadow, climb clover slopes, cross a stream and squeeze through the hedge before the fields open again. Expert redesign: closing clover heads and marsh spouts.

sections.name: The low meadow
sections.lesson: Stay low over the first roots. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
